title: File:Arizona & Utah - Lake Powell aerial view of Glen Canyon Dam (in the center of pic), Wahweap Marina (center top), the town of Page (center down) and on the left Colorado River downstream towards Grand Canyon (50294961102).jpg
author: Reinhard Link from Germany
description:
Page is a city in Northern Arizona near the Glen Canyon Dam and Lake Powell. Page was founded in 1957 as a housing community for workers and their families during the construction of nearby Glen Canyon Dam.  

Today Page is mainly a tourist hotspot as gateway to Lake Powell,  Rainbow Bridge, Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend.
